privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: This policy explains how StudioFlow handles information when invited teams use the service, including when a user connects Google Calendar.

service.title: What StudioFlow is
service.body: StudioFlow is an evolving internal and team-management product for organizing studio work, including projects, tasks, calendars, people, and related operations. It is currently used in a closed production-test stage.

accountData.title: Account and profile information
accountData.body: We store the information needed to authenticate you, maintain your profile, and determine your studio access. Depending on what you or your studio provide, this can include your name, sign-in email, avatar, role, job title, location, birthday, start date, and studio membership.

workspaceData.title: Information entered in StudioFlow
workspaceData.body: StudioFlow stores the project, task, calendar event, team, leave, contractor, and other operational information that authorized users enter into the service. This information is used to provide the workspace features and is visible according to the access controls within the relevant studio.

googleAccess.title: Google Calendar data we access
googleAccess.bodyOne: If you choose to connect Google Calendar, StudioFlow uses Google OAuth and requests your basic Google identity (OpenID and email) plus permission to create and manage calendars created by StudioFlow. We receive and store the email address of the Google account you selected so the connection can be identified in StudioFlow.
googleAccess.bodyTwo: StudioFlow creates a separate secondary calendar named for your studio (for example, “Studio name Team”) and manages events on that app-created calendar. StudioFlow does not write to your primary Google calendar and does not request access to manage calendars that it did not create.

googleUse.title: How the Google integration works
googleUse.bodyOne: Google Calendar access is used to project relevant StudioFlow calendar events into the secondary calendar. The current integration is one-way from StudioFlow to Google Calendar. It does not import Google Calendar events into StudioFlow and does not add attendees or send invitations.
googleUse.bodyTwo: StudioFlow stores connection metadata and event mappings to create, update, and safely remove its own projections without duplicating them. Google user data is not used for advertising and is not sold.

credentials.title: Google credentials
credentials.body: StudioFlow stores an encrypted Google refresh token in private server-side storage so that requested synchronization can continue without asking you to authorize every time. Stored access and refresh tokens are not exposed to the browser. Google may issue short-lived access tokens to the server when the integration is used.

disconnect.title: Disconnecting Google Calendar
disconnect.body: You can disconnect Google Calendar from your StudioFlow profile. StudioFlow first attempts to delete the exact app-created secondary Google calendar, then removes local event mappings, revokes the Google authorization, and removes the stored integration credentials and connection record. If Google authorization is already invalid, the local integration can still be removed. Disconnecting does not delete your StudioFlow events or other workspace data.

limitedUse.title: Google API data and Limited Use
limitedUse.body: StudioFlow’s use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the <policy>Google API Services User Data Policy</policy>, including its Limited Use requirements. We use Google data only to provide the user-facing connection and calendar synchronization described in this policy, except where another use is required for security or by law.

retention.title: Data retention and deletion
retention.body: We retain account and workspace data while it is needed to operate the relevant account or studio, and retain integration data while the connection is active. You may ask us about access to or deletion of your information. Some records may remain for a reasonable period in backups or where needed for security, dispute resolution, or legal obligations.

security.title: Security
security.body: We use access controls, database row-level policies, server-only credential storage, and encryption for stored Google refresh tokens. We take reasonable measures to protect information, but no online service or storage method can guarantee absolute security.

providers.title: Infrastructure and service providers
providers.body: StudioFlow relies on service providers to operate the product, including Supabase for database, authentication, and storage services; Vercel for application hosting; and Google APIs when you enable the Google Calendar integration. These providers process information as needed to deliver their services and under their own applicable terms and privacy practices.

updates.title: Policy updates
updates.body: We may update this policy as StudioFlow evolves. The date at the top will show when it was last revised. If a change materially affects how Google user data is used, we will provide appropriate notice and seek consent where required before using that data in a new way.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions or data requests can be sent to <email>studioflow.notifications@gmail.com</email>.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.introduction: These terms set out the practical rules for using StudioFlow during its closed production-test and evolving beta stage.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of these terms
acceptance.body: By accessing or using StudioFlow, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service. If you use StudioFlow for a studio or team, you confirm that you are authorized to do so.

purpose.title: Purpose of StudioFlow
purpose.body: StudioFlow helps invited studios and teams organize projects, tasks, calendars, people, and related internal work. Access is currently provided for internal use and controlled production testing.

beta.title: Evolving product
beta.body: StudioFlow is still evolving. Features may be incomplete, change, or be removed as the product is tested and improved. Please use appropriate judgment before relying on the service for critical or time-sensitive decisions.

account.title: Account responsibility
account.body: You are responsible for keeping your sign-in method secure, providing accurate information, and promptly reporting suspected unauthorized access. Do not share access in a way that bypasses your studio’s permissions.

permitted.title: Permitted use
permitted.body: You may use StudioFlow for legitimate studio and team-management activities within the access granted to you. You must respect other users, confidential workspace information, and applicable laws.

misuse.title: Prohibited misuse
misuse.body: Do not attempt to access another user’s or studio’s data without permission, interfere with the service, probe or bypass security controls, upload malicious code, misuse integrations, automate abusive traffic, or use StudioFlow for unlawful, deceptive, or harmful activity.

content.title: Your content and data
content.body: You and your studio retain ownership of the content and data you enter. You permit StudioFlow and its service providers to host, process, and display that information only as needed to operate, secure, maintain, and improve the service. You are responsible for having the right to submit the information you provide.

integrations.title: Third-party integrations
integrations.bodyOne: Optional integrations, including Google Calendar, are also governed by the relevant third party’s terms and policies. When you connect an integration, you authorize StudioFlow to take the actions described in the product and Privacy Policy on your behalf.
integrations.bodyTwo: The current Google Calendar integration synchronizes StudioFlow events one way into a secondary calendar created by StudioFlow. Third-party services can change, interrupt, or revoke access, and StudioFlow cannot guarantee their availability or behavior.

availability.title: Availability and service changes
availability.body: We aim to keep StudioFlow useful and available, but do not promise uninterrupted access or a service-level commitment. We may maintain, change, suspend, or discontinue features or access when reasonably needed, including for security, testing, or product development.

liability.title: Reasonable limitations
liability.body: StudioFlow is provided on an evolving, as-available basis. We will use reasonable care in operating it, but to the extent permitted by law, we are not responsible for indirect losses, lost opportunities, or losses caused by third-party services, unauthorized use outside our control, or decisions made solely from StudioFlow data. Keep separate copies of information you cannot afford to lose. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot legally be limited.

termination.title: Termination and access removal
termination.body: You may stop using StudioFlow at any time. Studio administrators may remove team access, and we may suspend or remove access where reasonably necessary for security, misuse, legal compliance, or the end of a production test. Data handling after access ends is described in the Privacy Policy.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms as StudioFlow evolves. The date at the top will identify the latest version. We will provide reasonable notice of material changes when appropriate; continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms can be sent to <email>studioflow.notifications@gmail.com</email>.

openingFx.required: Value every nonzero foreign opening balance, including archived accounts, before finalizing setup.
openingFx.legacy: This finalized setup has unvalued foreign openings. Complete each valuation once to restore cash history; original balances stay locked.
openingFx.nbu: Use the NBU rate effective on {date}. If unavailable, enter an explicit manual historical rate.
openingFx.confirm: I confirm this cutover valuation using the selected rate source. Saving completes this opening valuation permanently.
openingFx.invalid: Enter a valid positive historical rate for the cutover date.
openingFx.changed: The opening balance or setup changed. Refresh and review the valuation again.
openingFx.unavailable: No applicable historical rate could be resolved. Retry NBU or choose a manual historical rate; nothing has been saved.
openingFx.locked: This opening valuation is already finalized and cannot be changed.

overview.title: Finance overview
overview.historyIncomplete: Cash history is incomplete: complete the missing foreign opening valuations in Accounts.
overview.receivableFx: Some receivables need an FX assumption.
overview.chartDescription: Recorded daily cash is a solid line. Projected daily cash is dashed. Today's forecast starts at current FX valuations. Use the data table for exact dates and values.
overview.chartInteraction: Select a point for its date and value.
overview.chartScale: Chart unavailable at this scale. Exact amounts are shown in the table.
overview.valuationHelp: History includes opening cash and recorded movements at their stored reporting valuations. The forecast starts from all recorded account balances valued at today's assumptions, then adds remaining expected cash. A valuation difference at today is not a cash movement. Missing opening valuations make history unavailable until completed in Accounts.
overview.emptyUpcoming: No dated expected cash in this period.
overview.emptyFlows: No recorded cash flow in this period.
overview.emptyBudget: No budget or forecast activity in this period.
overview.controlCenter: Current cash, near-term payments and priorities · {currency}
overview.allClear: No overdue payments or missing inputs in this forecast.

forecast.varianceOrder: Largest absolute variances first. A dash means no complete budget baseline.
forecast.selectSnapshot: Select a saved forecast to compare expectations with subsequent cash.
forecast.emptySnapshots: No saved forecasts yet. Save a snapshot from Forecast to start a comparison.
forecast.invalidManualFx: Invalid manual assumptions were not applied. The forecast below uses available default rates; correct the assumptions and apply again.
forecast.title: Budget & Forecast
forecast.description: Cash planning from recorded money and remaining expected payments.
forecast.scenarioHelp: Confirmed includes agreed payments, including estimates. Including planned also includes tentative items; it is not an optimistic or pessimistic scenario.
forecast.cutover: Recorded actuals begin on {date}; earlier cash history is unavailable.
forecast.incomplete: Incomplete forecast. Amounts are known subtotals only: undated cash, missing rates, unknown costs and ungenerated periods may change the result. Review the attention list below.
forecast.cashHelp: Month-end cash adds only remaining expected net cash to this balance. Foreign cash is valued using the same forecast assumptions.
forecast.definitions: Actual is recorded cash in the period. Remaining forecast is unsettled expected cash. Full-period forecast = Actual + Remaining. Budget is only the approved comparison baseline. A dash means no budget; * means a missing valuation.
forecast.empty: No budget or cash items in this period.
forecast.timingHelp: Expected payment dates take priority over due dates. Past outgoing dates move to today. Incoming payments without a date or with a past date require new timing and stay outside the dated forecast. Due dates never change.
forecast.noIssues: No timing, valuation or coverage issues found.

issues.stale_incoming: Incoming payment needs a revised date
issues.ungenerated_period: A schedule occurrence is missing; retry the forecast or use the recovery action
issues.unscheduled_project: Contract amount has no payment schedule
issues.ungenerated_supervision: Generate this supervision month in Project Finance

forecast.fxHelp: Future FX is unknown. NBU rates effective today are held constant across the horizon for UAH reporting. Manual assumptions override NBU; leave blank to retry NBU. Other reporting currencies require manual rates. Actuals retain their historical valuations. Save a snapshot to preserve these assumptions.
forecast.budgetHelp: Enter approved amounts directly in {currency}. Any budget FX assumption belongs in the revision note; it never reprices actuals or generates expected payments. Saving approves a new immutable category/year revision. Enter zero to remove an amount deliberately.
forecast.historyLimit: Latest 100 revisions for this year, filtered to the selected category. All revisions remain stored.
forecast.snapshotHelp: Save current expectations with their dates, classifications, FX assumptions, coverage gaps and budget revision references. Actual ledger rows are not copied. Comparison shows net cash recorded after capture, dated from the capture day through the horizon; the current month may still be in progress.
forecast.savedContext: Saved {date}, through {through}. Attention items at capture: {count}.
forecast.legacySnapshot: This snapshot predates reliable posting order. Its saved forecast is unchanged; capture a new snapshot to compare subsequent cash.

errors.forbidden: Only active studio administrators can change cash plans.
errors.invalid: Check amounts, category and the revision note, then try again.
errors.conflict: This budget changed. Reload the page before approving a new revision.
errors.fx: Enter a positive exchange rate with up to 10 decimals. Reload if these assumptions are from an earlier date.

project.overrideVisitPrice: Use a manual price for this visit
project.retainSettlement: Keep {amount} as a fully paid replacement expectation and cancel the remaining balance.
project.cancelExpectationHelp: This closes the unpaid balance and preserves the original amount, agreement and payment history. It does not change cash or the project contract total.
project.title: Finance
project.noAgreement: Set the agreed value and currency before adding design payments.
project.monthHelp: Monthly terms cover full calendar months: start on the first day and, if specified, end on the last day. Leave the end empty for an ongoing arrangement.
project.amendHelp: Saves a new revision. Existing payments are kept. Revise unpaid payments separately; supervision changes must start after already generated months.
project.editHelp: Changes are recorded. Amount, currency, due date and agreement state are locked after any settlement; expected timing can still change.
project.collectionHelp: Collected shows money matched to these payments, net of released matches. Unscheduled contract value has no forecast date.
project.generateHelp: Create up to 12 months at a time. Existing months are skipped. Payments fall on month-end and remain planned until explicitly marked collectible; no cash is recorded.
project.extraVisit: This visit is an extra charge outside the monthly retainer.

errors.visitPriceChanged: The applicable visit agreement has changed. Refresh and check the price.
errors.retentionRequired: Confirm that the retained payment will be kept in a replacement expectation.
errors.cancellationRequired: Use Cancel expectation and provide a reason.
errors.duplicateCharge: This visit or month already has a payment. Edit or match the existing payment instead.
errors.overScheduled: Scheduled design payments would exceed the contract value. Amend the agreement or revise unpaid payments first.
errors.currencyLocked: Design payment currency must match the agreement. Agreement currency is fixed once a schedule exists.
errors.settledLocked: This payment has settlement history. Its amount and contractual terms are locked; only expected timing, description and collectible status can change.
errors.effectiveDate: Use a later effective date, after all generated supervision months. Existing payments are not rewritten.
errors.monthRange: Choose first-of-month dates within active monthly terms, up to 12 months per batch.
errors.visitNotBillable: This visit has no applicable per-visit terms. Under monthly terms, confirm that it is an additional charge.
errors.agreementRequired: Save the project agreement before scheduling design payments.

planning.title: Expected payments
planning.description: Plan payments and match them with actual money movements.
planning.empty: No expected payments in this view.
planning.differentExpectedDate: Use a different expected payment date
planning.plannedPaymentHelp: Keep this payment in the plan until the amount and commitment are confirmed.
planning.trackReceivable: Count the remaining amount as receivable
planning.trackObligation: Count the remaining amount as an obligation
planning.establishedAdvancedHelp: Turn this off when the payment is confirmed but the amount is not yet collectible or payable.
planning.attentionSummary: {count, plural, one {# payment needs attention} other {# payments need attention}}
planning.recordFor: Payment for {item} · {currency}. Choose how much to settle; any excess stays unapplied.
planning.noPayments: No available payments on this page.
planning.matchHelp: Choose an existing payment in the same currency and direction. Matching does not create cash; ordinary ledger movements remain searchable here.
planning.unmatchHelp: Release the remaining allocation without changing the actual payment. Add a reason for the audit trail.
planning.unappliedHelp: Money explicitly recorded for later matching, plus remaining or released amounts from prior matches. Ordinary completed transactions are not shown here.
planning.categoriesHelp: Reusable studio categories determine reporting classification. Rename or archive them without rewriting posted history.
planning.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete “{name}”? This category has no Finance references.
planning.archiveCategoryConfirm: Archive “{name}”? Existing Finance history will stay unchanged.
planning.deleteCategoryHelp: This unused custom category can be deleted permanently.
planning.archiveCategoryHelp: This category is retained for Finance history and can only be archived.
planning.restoreCategoryHelp: Restore this category to make it available in Finance forms again.

errors.categoryScheduleRequired: This category is required by an active or future Finance schedule. Revise or stop the dependent schedules before archiving it.
errors.forbidden: Finance is available to active studio administrators only.
errors.invalid: Check the required fields, amounts and dates.
errors.save: Could not save. Check the item and payment are still available, then try again.
errors.duplicate: This category already exists. Use or restore the existing category.
errors.overallocated: The amount exceeds the item's remaining balance or the payment's available amount.
errors.version: This item changed. Close and reopen it before saving.
errors.conflict: This request was already saved with different values. Reopen the form before recording another change.
errors.locked: Currency, direction and reporting nature are fixed once an item has settlement history.
errors.belowSettled: The expected amount cannot be less than the amount already settled.
errors.incompatible: Choose an active item and a payment with matching currency, direction and reporting nature.

movements.title: Movements
movements.descriptionText: Actual studio cash. Opening balances are kept separate from cash flow.
movements.advanceForMatching: Keep this as an advance for later matching
movements.advanceForMatchingHelp: Use for customer credits or studio prepayments that should later settle an expected payment.
movements.feeHelp: Charged separately to the source account, in addition to the amount sent. Record fees in another account as a separate outgoing movement.
movements.nbuHelp: The rate effective on the financial date will be fetched when recording. If unavailable, enter a manual rate. It does not set the actual amount received in a transfer.
movements.ownerHelp: Reduces cash and is classified as an owner distribution, outside operating expenses.
movements.historyHelp: Recorded movements cannot be edited or deleted. Correct a mistake with an explicit reversal, then record the replacement.
movements.setupRequired: Finalize Finance setup before recording actual money movements.
movements.refundHelp: Refund for “{category}”. Record the amount actually returned to or from the original account. Historical valuation uses the refund date.
movements.reversalHelp: Reverse “{category}” and all its account effects, including fees, at their original valuation. This corrects a recording error; use an actual refund for money returned later.
movements.reversalConfirm: I confirm this entry should be reversed. The original record will remain visible.

errors.forbidden: Only an active studio administrator can record Finance movements.
errors.invalid: Check the accounts, financial date, positive amounts, category, and currency decimal places. Same-currency transfers must send and receive the same amount before fees.
errors.fx: A valid historical rate is unavailable. Choose an explicit manual rate for each foreign currency, or retry the dated NBU lookup. No movement was recorded.
errors.save: Unable to confirm the recording. Retry this same form to check or complete it safely before starting another movement.
errors.conflict: This submission was already recorded with different details. Refresh and review history before recording another movement.
errors.archived: An account is archived or unavailable. Review the accounts before recording.
errors.reversed: This movement has already been reversed. Refresh to see its history.
errors.refundsFirst: Reverse the linked refund entries before reversing their original movement.
errors.refundAmount: The refund exceeds the amount still refundable on the original movement.

Finance.title: Finance
Finance.description: Studio accounts and opening balances. Administrator access only.
Finance.currencySearchEmpty: No supported currency matches your search.
Finance.cutoverHelp: Opening balances are the money held at the beginning of this date. They are not income or expenses.
Finance.accountsHelp: Add each independently tracked bank balance, cash wallet, or currency pocket once. A debit card using an existing account does not need another account.
Finance.openingHelp: Enter the balance at cutover, including zero or a negative balance. This currency supports {digits} decimal places.
Finance.openingLockedHelp: Setup is finalized. Existing opening balances and currencies are fixed; new accounts start at zero.
Finance.emptyAccounts: Add an account and enter its balance at cutover.
Finance.setupFirst: Save the reporting currency and cutover date before adding accounts.
Finance.archivedHelp: Archiving preserves opening balances and account history. Restore an account to edit its name.
Finance.finalizeHelp: Review all accounts, including archived accounts. Finalizing locks the reporting currency, cutover date, and existing account currencies and opening balances. You can still rename, archive, or restore accounts and add new accounts with zero opening balances.
Finance.confirmFinalize: I have checked the reporting currency, cutover date, and every opening balance. I understand these values will be locked.
Finance.finalizedHelp: The cutover and reporting currency are fixed to preserve historical meaning. Account balances remain in their own currencies.

errors.futureCutover: Setup cannot be finalized before the cutover date. Wait until that date, or correct the date in draft settings.
errors.accountRequestConflict: This account submission already succeeded with different details. Close this form, refresh, and edit the existing account.
errors.forbidden: Only an active studio administrator can manage Finance.
errors.save: Unable to save. Your changes may not have been saved. Refresh and check before trying again.
errors.settings: Choose a supported reporting currency and a valid cutover date from 1900 onward.
errors.account: Enter an account name, a supported currency, and an opening balance with the correct decimal places (up to 10 digits before the decimal).
errors.locked: Setup was finalized. Refresh to see the locked settings and opening balances.
errors.activeAccount: Add or restore at least one active account before finalizing.
errors.invalid: Check the form and confirm your selection.

schedules.remittancesHelp: Leave blank if unknown. Enter 0 to confirm none, or a known amount in addition to net pay.
schedules.completeCostHelp: Record or correct a previously unknown cost for this payroll period. A reason is required. Salary terms and recorded payments remain unchanged. Settled cost components cannot be changed here.
schedules.explicitZeroHelp: Enter 0 to explicitly confirm there is no cost.
schedules.title: Compensation & recurring
schedules.description: Set employee pay and regular studio payments.
schedules.name: Payment name
schedules.revisionDateHelp: Choose the month the change takes effect. Earlier terms and payment history stay unchanged.
schedules.taxWarning: Enter the supplied deductions and payout. Taxes are not calculated automatically.
schedules.recurringHelp: Set the amount and timing of a regular studio payment.
schedules.datesHelp: Days 29–31 use the last day of shorter months. Quarterly and yearly payments follow the chosen start month.
schedules.bonusHelp: A one-off take-home payment, separate from salary and Leaderboard awards.
schedules.generateHelp: Choose month-start dates, up to 12 months per batch. Existing occurrences are skipped. This creates plans only; confirm earned obligations and record actual payments in Expected items.
schedules.stopHelp: Choose the first month without accruals. Unsettled plans from that month are cancelled; earned and settled obligations stay unchanged.
schedules.empty: No compensation or recurring schedules yet.
schedules.sourceHelp: Finance occurrence: employee and service period are permanent. Payout amounts and contractual dates are locked; forecast dates, cancellation and earned status can be updated.

errors.costLocked: This cost cannot be changed here. Use a future compensation revision for planned payroll; settled or established costs are protected.
errors.costCategory: Restore the Employer taxes and contributions category in Finance → Categories before saving payroll costs.
errors.effectiveThroughInput: Choose an end month that is the same as or later than the effective-from month.
errors.compensationRequired: Enter the monthly compensation amount. For Before taxes, also enter deductions and employee payout.
errors.employerCostRequired: Enter an amount when Additional employer costs is Yes.
errors.effectiveDate: Choose a future month after the latest revision, outside any locked or multi-month service period.
errors.range: Choose month-start dates in order, no more than 12 months apart.
errors.employee: Choose an active studio member without another active compensation schedule. Rehired members start after the previous schedule stops.
errors.locked: Employee payout amounts, currency, category and contractual dates are locked for this occurrence.
errors.version: This schedule changed. Refresh before saving.
errors.conflict: This request was already used with different details. Reopen the form.
errors.amount: Check currency precision and compensation: net must equal payout; gross must equal payout plus explicit deductions.
errors.save: The schedule could not be saved. Check its status, categories and dates, then retry.
errors.group: Choose an available group and a name of up to 80 characters.
errors.groupName: A group with this name already exists.

schedules.recurringSectionHelp: Rent, subscriptions and other regular payments.
schedules.payrollEmpty: No compensation agreements yet. Add an employee’s monthly pay to get started.
schedules.recurringEmpty: No recurring payments yet. Add rent, a subscription or another regular payment.
schedules.payoutNext: Pay on day {day} of the following month
schedules.payoutCurrent: Pay on day {day} of the same month
schedules.costsIncompleteHelp: Some remittances or employer costs are unspecified. Review the agreement or complete known costs for individual payroll periods in Expected payments.
schedules.groupEmpty: No recurring payments in this group yet.
schedules.setupHelp: Enter compensation for the people you want to set up. Selected rows save separately; successful rows stay saved if another needs correction.
schedules.setupCostHelp: Blank means unknown. Enter 0 to confirm no additional cost.
schedules.setupSelect: Enter an amount or select at least one employee.
schedules.setupRetry: The result could not be confirmed. Retry with the same values, or reopen setup to see which agreements were saved.
schedules.moveRetry: Some rules could not be moved. Completed moves are saved; retry the remaining selection.
schedules.completeCosts: Complete payroll costs in Expected payments
